associatedDeviceIds.description: Bounded device identifiers linked to this account (max 50)

UserWorkspace.description: Account-isolated workspace storage for a CreatorFlow user

TelemetryEvent.title: CreatorFlow Telemetry Event
TelemetryEvent.description: Account-attributed product usage event for Owner Analytics

AdminRecord.title: CreatorFlow Admin Authorization Record
AdminRecord.description: Server-managed system owner or administrator role grant mapped to Firebase UID

/accounts/{accountId}.description: Private user account records strictly isolated to owner or system owner

/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}.description: Server-only Cashfree recurring subscription records (Admin SDK only)

/payment_events/{eventId}.description: Server-only webhook idempotency and payment audit log (Admin SDK only)

/server_devices/{deviceId}.description: Server-only device abuse and risk scoring records (Admin SDK only)

/server_upgrade_requests/{requestId}.description: Server-only upgrade request audit records (Admin SDK only)

/plan_demand_stats/{docId}.description: Server-only pre-launch plan demand aggregation (Admin SDK only)

/server_usage_records/{recordId}.description: Server-only usage audit records (Admin SDK only)

/user_ai_credentials/{uid}.description: Server-only encrypted BYOK Gemini API keys isolated per user UID (Admin SDK only)

/ai_usage_metrics/{uid}.description: Server-only per-user BYOK AI usage metrics and telemetry (Admin SDK only)
